title.en: Australia politics live: One Nation files three years of overdue financial returns hours before deadline
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：一国党在截止日期前数小时提交三年逾期财务报表

summary.en: One Nation, an Australian political party, submitted three years of overdue financial returns just hours before a regulatory deadline. Separately, Liberal MP Andrew Wallace expressed ongoing concerns about a gambling bill, having previously voted against his party on the issue.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚政党“一国党”在监管截止日期前数小时提交了三年逾期的财务报表。与此同时，自由党议员安德鲁·华莱士表示，他对一项赌博法案的担忧依然存在，他周二曾就此法案与本党立场相左。

body.en: Meanwhile Liberal MP Andrew Wallace says concerns remain over gambling bill after crossing the floor on Tuesday. Follow today’s news live Follow our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ‘Collapsing confidence’ in housing market, Wilson says Tim Wilson has jumped on that reporting around rent increases and says there has been a collapse in confidence since the budget which is hurting renters. We’ve had, since the budget, collapsing confidence, a lack of will to invest in housing that is going to be available for rentals. We’re seeing a complete disaster in the housing market, and we know that’s only going to do one thing while the government continues to overshoot its migration target, and that is an increase in rents on Australians struggling to save a first home deposit. There is an awful lot that goes into determining rents in Australia, and the thing that Treasury modelled in the context of the budget, what is the isolated effect of what the government actually changed about the housing market. And if I just step back for a second, we’ve got a broken housing system in our country, and it’s the renters of Australia who are bearing the brunt of really 40 years of government’s not doing enough about this problem. I think that Clare sadly needs to start taking a bit of responsibility for her housing policy. But also, Clare, stop gaslighting Australians, stop gaslighting the mum and dads who are currently watching this show and feeling the impact of your toxic housing taxes … She can sit on your show and defend her policies, but the evidence on the ground, the evidence from the experts, is that Labor’s toxic housing taxes are smashing the market. title.en: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
title.zh: 被解职的乌克兰国防部长呼吁举行总统选举

summary.en: Ukraine's former defense minister has called for a presidential election, despite martial law, which has suspended elections since February 2022.
summary.zh: 乌克兰前国防部长呼吁举行总统选举，尽管自2022年2月以来，戒严法已暂停了所有选举。

body.en:
Former Ukrainian defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov has called for wartime elections, in what many see as the biggest challenge to Volodymyr Zelensky's presidency since war broke out with Russia in February 2022.

"Democracy cannot be held hostage by Russia," said Fedorov, 35, in a video posted to YouTube on Tuesday, adding that Ukraine is fighting "precisely because we want to remain a free European state".

Since Russia's invasion Ukraine has been under martial law, which means elections are suspended.

Fedorov, who did not mention Zelensky by name in the video, was unexpectedly fired from his role as defence minister in late July, just six months after his appointment.

Zelensky is yet to respond to the video from Fedorov, whose dismissal sparked protests across the country .

During his tenure as defence minister, Fedorov was credited with energising the ministry, heading a drive against corruption and using data to analyse and try to improve performance on the front line.

His dismissal is widely accepted to have been related to tensions between him and army commander-in-chief, Oleksandr Syrskyi. Syrskyi was also replaced several weeks later, after weeks of protests piled pressure onto the Ukrainian president.

Fedorov gave no indication as to his own political plans in the YouTube video, instead focusing on the need for a "legal, safe, and realistic mechanism that will allow Ukraine to restore a full democratic process even amidst a prolonged war".

He added that the country was facing a "systemic crisis of governance" and is "scared of change", and pointed to corruption in Ukraine as one of the things hurting the country's war effort.

Zelensky has since appointed Yevgeniy Khmara, a career intelligence official with a low political profile, as acting defence minister.

Other posts in Zelensky's government were offered to Fedorov, including deputy prime minister for military innovation, but the 35-year-old has said he would only return as defence minister.

A former minister of digital transformation, Fedorov set up a volunteer "IT Army of Ukraine" to launch cyber-attacks against Russians in the early days after its full-scale invasion.

Later, he led a successful fundraising campaign called the Army of Drones and brought in elements of "gamification" to the war, designing a system that awarded Ukrainian military units with credits for hitting Russian targets.

As defence minister, his focus on drones, high-tech warfare and procurement continued, and saw him ask SpaceX founder Elon Musk to stop Russia from using Starlink satellites for drone attacks.

The move has been credited with causing considerable disruption to Russia's frontline operations and advance.

body.zh: 乌克兰前国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫呼吁举行战时选举，许多人认为这是自 2022 年 2 月与俄罗斯爆发战争以来对弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基总统任期的最大挑战。 35 岁的费多罗夫周二在 YouTube 上发布的一段视频中表示，“民主不能被俄罗斯扣为人质”，并补充说乌克兰正在战斗“正是因为我们想继续成为一个自由的欧洲国家”。 自俄罗斯入侵以来，乌克兰一直处于戒严状态，这意味着选举被暂停。 费多罗夫在视频中没有提到泽连斯基的名字，他在七月下旬出人意料地被解除了国防部长职务，此时距离他被任命仅六个月。 泽伦斯基尚未对费多罗夫的视频做出回应，费多罗夫的解雇引发了全国各地的抗议。 在担任国防部长期间，费多罗夫被认为为国防部注入了活力，领导了反腐败运动，并利用数据分析并试图提高前线的绩效。 人们普遍认为，他被解职与他和陆军总司令亚历山大·西尔斯基之间的紧张关系有关。几周后，在持续数周的抗议活动给乌克兰总统带来压力后，西尔斯基也被替换。 费多罗夫在 YouTube 视频中没有透露他自己的政治计划，而是重点强调需要一个“合法、安全和现实的机制，让乌克兰即使在长期战争中也能恢复全面的民主进程”。 他补充说，该国正面临“系统性治理危机”，并且“害怕变革”，并指出乌克兰的腐败是损害该国战争努力的因素之一。 此后，泽伦斯基任命政治形象较低的职业情报官员叶夫根尼·赫马拉（Yevgeniy Khmara）担任代理国防部长。 泽连斯基政府向费多罗夫提供了其他职位，包括负责军事创新的副总理，但这位 35 岁的人表示，他只会以国防部长的身份回归。 费多罗夫曾任数字化转型部长，他组建了一支志愿者“乌克兰IT军”，在俄罗斯全面入侵后的初期对俄罗斯发动网络攻击。 后来，他成功领导了一场名为“无人机军团”的筹款活动，并将“游戏化”元素引入战争，设计了一个系统，为乌克兰军事单位击中俄罗斯目标提供奖励。 作为国防部长，他继续关注无人机、高科技战争和采购，并要求 SpaceX 创始人埃隆·马斯克阻止俄罗斯使用星链卫星进行无人机攻击。 此举被认为对俄罗斯前线行动和前进造成了相当大的干扰。 费多罗夫在被解雇后不久在脸书上发帖，列出了他的成就并......

reflection.en: The call for elections, even amidst martial law, highlights the deep human desire for accountable leadership. Yahweh's word reminds us that the character of those in authority profoundly impacts the well-being of a nation. When leaders govern with integrity, the people find cause for hope and stability.
reflection.zh: 即使在戒严时期，呼吁举行选举也凸显了人类对负责任领导的深切渴望。雅伟的话语提醒我们，掌权者的品格深刻影响着一个国家的福祉。当领袖以正直治理时，人民就能找到希望和稳定的理由。

title.en: Trump says no Iran talks planned, shares map showing Hormuz as 'new US territory'
title.zh: 特朗普称未计划与伊朗谈判，并分享地图将霍尔木兹海峡标为“美国新领土”

summary.en: US President Donald Trump stated that no talks with Iran are planned, while also sharing a map that depicted the Strait of Hormuz as "new US territory." Iran has maintained its stance that it will not reopen the vital waterway unless the US lifts its blockade of Iranian ports.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，目前没有与伊朗进行谈判的计划，同时他还分享了一张地图，将霍尔木兹海峡标注为“美国新领土”。伊朗坚称，除非美国解除对伊朗港口的封锁，否则不会重新开放这条重要的航道。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has said no talks with Iran are underway and none are scheduled, as he posted a map showing the Strait of Hormuz as a new US territory.

Trump has been pressing his threat to claim sovereignty over the crucial energy waterway as the nearly six-month-old Iran war grinds on with little sign of resolution.

Trump's envoy and son-in-law Jared Kushner had said on Monday that the US and Iran were having "very positive and active conversations", but the president denied that was the case.

"There are no talks or conversations going on, or scheduled, with the Islamic Republic of Iran. The Naval Blockade remains in full force and effect," Trump wrote on his Truth Social network on Tuesday night.

"The Hormuz Strait is open and operating. All water mines have been removed or detonated."

US sources told the Agence-France Presse news agency there had been "positive" discussions with the Iranians, but added that Trump had decided to wait and asked his team not to engage until Iran was ready to make a deal.

In recent weeks, there has been a lull in fighting, though the United Arab Emirates has recently accused Iran of firing two ballistic missiles — which landed at sea — targeting "maritime navigation." Iran, however, denied firing a missile toward the UAE.

Soon after, the UAE announced that "in light of regional escalations" it was halting all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran.

The UAE bore the brunt of Iranian missile and drone attacks in the first period of the war, but had not reported any attacks since the US and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding in June that was meant to halt the fighting.

Earlier on Tuesday, Trump posted a map on Truth Social showing the Strait of Hormuz as a "NEW U.S. Territory".

Iran has effectively shut down the chokepoint , through which a fifth of the world's oil would usually transit, in retaliation for the war launched by the US and Israel in late February.

Trump revisited the idea again earlier in the week in comments to reporters in the Oval Office.

This is not the first time that Trump, faced with a foreign policy obstacle, has threatened to annex foreign territory.

Since returning to power in 2025, he has threatened to make Canada the 51st US state, seize Greenland and Cuba, and has even alluded to taking control of the Gaza Strip, without following through on any of these threats.

Before the Iran war erupted on 28 February, the Strait of Hormuz was an open waterway with free passage.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，与伊朗的谈判尚未进行，也没有安排任何谈判，他发布了一张地图，显示霍尔木兹海峡是美国的新领土。 随着近六个月的伊朗战争持续进行，几乎没有解决的迹象，特朗普一直在施压威胁，要求对这条重要的能源航道拥有主权。 特朗普的特使兼女婿贾里德·库什纳周一表示，美国和伊朗正在进行“非常积极和积极的对话”，但总统否认了这一点。 “与伊朗伊斯兰共和国没有正在进行或计划进行任何谈判或对话。海军封锁仍然完全有效，”特朗普周二晚上在他的真相社交网络上写道。 “霍尔木兹海峡已开放并正在运行。所有水雷均已被清除或引爆。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 美国消息人士告诉法新社，与伊朗方面进行了“积极”的讨论，但补充说，特朗普决定等待，并要求他的团队在伊朗准备达成协议之前不要参与。 最近几周，战斗陷入了平静，尽管阿拉伯联合酋长国最近指责伊朗发射了两枚弹道导弹——这些导弹落在海上——瞄准“海上航行”。然而，伊朗否认向阿联酋发射导弹。 不久之后，阿联酋宣布“鉴于地区局势升级”，将停止与伊朗的所有贸易、商业往来和金融交易。 在战争的第一阶段，阿联酋首当其冲地遭受了伊朗的导弹和无人机袭击，但自美国和伊朗六月签署旨在停止战斗的谅解备忘录以来，阿联酋没有报告任何袭击事件。 周二早些时候，特朗普在真相社交网站上发布了一张地图，将霍尔木兹海峡显示为“新的美国领土”。 伊朗实际上已经关闭了这个咽喉要道，世界上五分之一的石油通常要经过这个咽喉要道，以报复美国和以色列在二月底发动的战争。 本周早些时候，特朗普在椭圆形办公室向记者发表评论时再次重新审视了这一想法。 这并不是特朗普第一次面临外交政策障碍威胁吞并外国领土。 自2025年重新掌权以来，他曾威胁要让加拿大成为美国第51个州，夺取格陵兰岛和古巴，甚至暗示要控制加沙地带，但没有兑现任何这些威胁。 在2月28日伊朗战争爆发之前，霍尔木兹海峡是一条开放水道，可以自由通行。 伊朗表示，在美国满足包括结束美国制裁在内的一系列全面要求之前，不会重新开放该海峡。

reflection.en: In a world where tensions rise and diplomatic paths seem closed, the call to be peacemakers remains vital. Yahweh blesses those who actively seek reconciliation and de-escalation, even when faced with provocative actions or hardened stances. May we pray for leaders to pursue understanding and peaceful resolutions, rather than escalating conflict.
reflection.zh: 在一个紧张局势加剧、外交途径似乎关闭的世界里，成为和平缔造者的呼召至关重要。雅伟赐福那些积极寻求和解与缓和局势的人，即使面对挑衅行为或强硬立场。愿我们为领导人祷告，使其寻求理解与和平解决方案，而非升级冲突。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Tupac Shakur murder trial: ‘You better treat me as a hostile witness,’ Suge Knight associate testifies – as it happened
title.zh: 图帕克·沙库尔谋杀案审判：医学专家就说唱歌手尸检作证——最新进展

summary.en: A forensic pathologist, Dr. Lisa Gavin, presented evidence from Tupac Shakur’s autopsy report and photos during the ongoing murder trial. The District Court Judge relayed questions from the jury directly to the medical examiner as the court seeks to understand the circumstances of the rapper's death.
summary.zh: 在图帕克·沙库尔谋杀案的审判中，法医病理学家丽莎·加文博士就说唱歌手的尸检报告和照片提供了证据。地区法院法官卡莉·基尔尼直接向法医转达了陪审团的几个问题。

body.en:
Dr. Lisa Gavin, a medical examiner, reviewed the autopsy report and photos of Shakur’s body, and said that the evidence showed his death was a homicide.

Some relatives of Shakur left the courtroom in response to the graphic photographs, while others looked away.

Former Las Vegas police detective Dean O’Kelley described responding to the scene of Shakur’s shooting, spotting the bullet cases in the middle of the street, and using traffic cones to try to protect the crime scene until investigators arrived.

“I told every attorney that tried to get me in here, you’d better treat me as a hostile witness,” James McDonald, an associate of Death Row Records co-founder Suge Knight, told the court, as he gave some details of reactions to Shakur’s shooting, but declined to answer other questions. “Me or anybody else bringing up the dead is wrong.”
body.zh: 内华达州克拉克县的法医病理学家丽莎·加文博士现在作为专家分析员出庭作证，审查图帕克·沙库尔尸检报告和尸体照片。 实际进行尸检的法医已经去世，凸显了在死亡实际发生 30 年后举行谋杀案审判的挑战。 加文指出，她 1996 年就读于医学院，但在解释证据方面拥有多年经验。

reflection.en: In the pursuit of justice, a trial meticulously examines evidence and testimony to uncover the truth. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that a thorough examination is crucial, ensuring all perspectives are heard before a judgment is made. This careful process reflects a societal commitment to accountability and the diligent search for facts.
reflection.zh: 在寻求公义的过程中，审判会细致地审查证据和证词，以揭示真相。箴言18:17提醒我们，在做出判断之前，彻底的审查至关重要，确保所有观点都被听取。这一严谨的过程反映了社会对问责制和勤勉寻求事实的承诺。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Harvard agrees to pay millions after morgue manager sold body parts
title.zh: 哈佛大学同意支付数百万美元，因太平间经理出售尸体器官

summary.en: Harvard Medical School has agreed to pay $53 million to settle claims from families whose loved ones' donated remains were allegedly mishandled by a former morgue manager who sold body parts.
summary.zh: 哈佛医学院已同意支付5300万美元，以了结那些家人捐赠的遗体被前太平间经理出售身体部位的指控。

body.en:
Harvard has agreed to pay $53 million (£39 million) to resolve lawsuits from families who alleged the university mishandled the bodies of loved ones donated to its medical school.

The settlement, proposed in a Boston court on Monday, would end the suits filed against Harvard ​Medical School (HMS) after former morgue manager Cedric Lodge pleaded guilty to stealing and selling human remains on the black market.

Lodge, 58, took parts from cadavers and sold them online in a scheme that allegedly ran from 2018 to 2021.

The medical school said in a letter it shared on Monday that multi-million dollar settlement funds will be set up for families once the court grants approval.

Lodge and six other co-conspirators who had no connection to Harvard were all indicted and pleaded guilty in 2025.

Prosecutors have alleged Lodge used his position as the manager of the "Anatomical Gifts Program" at the medical school to dismember cadavers donated for medical research.

Harvard students use donated bodies to study and practice medical procedures. When the school finishes using them, the cadavers are often cremated and remains returned to their families, or buried in the university's medical cemetery, according to the indictment .

Lodge and his wife sold the body parts to buyers in Pennsylvania and Massachusetts, the indictment states.

He was sentenced in December to eight years in prison, according to the Department of Justice. His wife was sentenced to one year and a day.

In 2023, a number of civil lawsuits were brought against Harvard alleging the university ignored Lodge's misconduct for several years until he was indicted.

While the cases were initially dismissed by a state court judge, the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court revived the suits last fall.

On Monday, both Harvard and the plaintiffs in those cases asked the court to approve the class-action settlement agreement valued at $53 million.

The university's letter - signed by George Daley, ⁠Harvard's dean of the faculty of medicine, and Bernard Chang, the dean for medical education at Harvard Medical School - said: "Lodge's criminal acts were morally reprehensible and inconsistent with the standards that Harvard University and HMS expect for the treatment of anatomical donors and their loved ones".

Starting in the 2027-2028 academic year, the medical school will also establish an annual financial-aid scholarship for medical students "in appreciation and in honour of all of our anatomical donors," the letter states.

It adds that while Lodge's sentencing and the settlement conclude the case, "the process of recovering from this painful incident continues".
body.zh: 哈佛同意支付 5300 万美元（3900 万英镑）来解决家庭提起的诉讼，这些家庭指控该大学对捐赠给其医学院的亲人遗体处理不当。 周一，波士顿一家法院提出的和解协议将结束针对哈佛医学院 (HMS) 的诉讼，此前停尸房经理塞德里克·洛奇 (Cedric Lodge) 承认在黑市上盗窃和出售人体遗骸。 58 岁的洛奇从尸体上取下零件并在网上出售，据称该计划从 2018 年持续到 2021 年。 该医学院在周一分享的一封信中表示，一旦法院批准，将为家庭设立数百万美元的和解基金。 洛奇和其他六名与哈佛无关的同谋均于 2025 年被起诉并认罪。 检察官指控洛奇利用其作为医学院“解剖礼物项目”经理的职位肢解捐赠用于医学研究的尸体。 哈佛大学的学生利用捐赠的遗体来学习和实践医疗程序。起诉书称，当学校使用完毕后，尸体通常会被火化，并将遗体送还给家人，或埋在大学的医学墓地。 起诉书称，洛奇和他的妻子将这些身体部位卖给了宾夕法尼亚州和马萨诸塞州的买家。 据司法部称，他于 12 月被判处八年监禁。他的妻子被判处一年零一天。 2023 年，哈佛大学提起多起民事诉讼，指控该大学多年来忽视洛奇的不当行为，直到他被起诉。 虽然这些案件最初被州法院法官驳回，但马萨诸塞州最高法院去年秋天恢复了诉讼。 周一，哈佛大学和这些案件的原告均要求法院批准价值 5300 万美元的集体诉讼和解协议。 哈佛大学医学院院长乔治·戴利（George Daley）和哈佛医学院医学教育院长伯纳德·张（Bernard Chang）签署的该大学的信函表示：“洛奇的犯罪行为在道德上应受到谴责，并且不符合哈佛大学和哈佛医学院期望的解剖捐献者及其亲人治疗标准。” 信中指出，从 2027-2028 学年开始，医学院还将为医学生设立年度经济援助奖学金，“以感谢和纪念我们所有的解剖捐赠者”。 它补充说，虽然洛奇的量刑和和解结束了此案，但“从这一痛苦事件中恢复的过程仍在继续”。

reflection.en: The news of donated human remains being exploited for profit is a stark reminder of the sacredness of human life, even in death. Yahweh created humanity in His own image, bestowing inherent dignity upon every person. This principle calls us to treat all human remains with profound respect, recognizing the enduring worth of each individual.
reflection.zh: 捐赠遗体被用于牟利的消息，严酷地提醒我们生命的神圣性，即使在死亡之后亦是如此。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了人类，赋予每个人固有的尊严。这一原则呼吁我们以深深的敬意对待所有人类遗骸，承认每个个体永恒的价值。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard dies aged 77
title.zh: ZZ Top 鼓手 Frank Beard 去世，享年 77 岁

summary.en: A statement on the blues-rock band's website said he died on Monday in hospice
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A statement on the blues-rock band's website said he died on Monday in hospice care at his ranch in Richmond, Texas, with family members at his side. His cause of death was not specified.

Beard's passing "necessitates the cancellation" of the band's tour dates this week in Utah and Colorado, the statement said.

ZZ Top was founded in 1969 and played their first live concert the following year. Together they released 15 studio and four live albums, with hit singles like Gimme All Your Lovin', Sleeping Bag, and Viva Las Vegas.

Members of the group have included founder and lead vocalist Billy Gibbons and the late Dusty Hill. When Hill died in 2021 , the group carried on performing with Elwood Francis as its bassist.

"Today, Elwood and I lost a great friend and collaborator, and the world lost one of the most naturally innovative drummers and a great and true son of Texas," Gibbons said.

"His signature backbeat was key to keeping ZZ on top. The band of which he was part for six decades is going to keep on keeping on as he had wished," he said.

ZZ Top, which was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2004, has continued touring throughout North America, Europe and South America.

Shows the group called off after Beard's death had been scheduled in Salt Lake City, Utah, on Monday and in Colorado Springs, Colorado, on Wednesday.

The group said it plans to resume its current The Big One! Tour over the weekend, with two dates at Austin City Limits, which the band said was one of Beard's favourite venues in "a city that had been something of a second home for him".

Beard joined the group after ZZ Top released its first single Salt Lick and later brought on Hill as its bassist, according to Rolling Stone , external .

Serving as the band's rhythmic force on drums, he anchored hits such as La Grange, Tush and Cheap Sunglasses, Rolling Stone said.

He became known as The Man With No Beard - despite his surname - because he was the only member of the Houston ensemble who didn't sport the lengthy facial hair the band became known for, the band has said.

The group's famous 1984 album Eliminator featured the hits Gimme All Your Lovin, Sharp Dressed Man and Legs. It sold more than 10m copies, was certified diamond , external , by The Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) in 1996. The album also earned a Grammy Award nomination.

In 1987, the group received another Grammy nod from the Recording Academy for their Afterburner album. In 2021, the group was also nominated for best music film for Sam Dunn's documentary That Little Ol' Band From Texas.
body.zh: 这支蓝调摇滚乐队网站上的一份声明称，他于周一在德克萨斯州里士满牧场的临终关怀中心去世，家人陪伴在侧。他的死因没有具体说明。 声明称，比尔德的去世“使得乐队必须取消”本周在犹他州和科罗拉多州的巡演。 ZZ Top 成立于 1969 年，并于次年举办了第一场现场音乐会。他们总共发行了 15 张录音室专辑和四张现场专辑，其中包括《Gimme All Your Lovin'》、《Sleeping Bag》和《Viva Las Vegas》等热门单曲。 该乐队的成员包括创始人兼主唱比利·吉本斯 (Billy Gibbons) 和已故的达斯蒂·希尔 (Dusty Hill)。 2021 年希尔去世后，该乐队继续演出，埃尔伍德·弗朗西斯担任贝斯手。 吉本斯说：“今天，埃尔伍德和我失去了一位伟大的朋友和合作者，世界失去了一位最具创新精神的鼓手和一位伟大而真正的德克萨斯之子。” “他标志性的强节奏是 ZZ 保持领先地位的关键。他加入了 60 年的乐队将继续按照他的愿望继续前进，”他说。 ZZ Top于2004年入选摇滚名人堂，并继续在北美、欧洲和南美进行巡演。 该节目在比尔德去世后取消，原定于周一在犹他州盐湖城和周三在科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯举行。 该团体表示计划恢复目前的 The Big One！周末巡演，在奥斯汀城市极限 (Austin City Limits) 举行了两次约会，乐队称这是比尔德最喜欢的场地之一，“这座城市对他来说就像是第二个家”。 据《滚石》外部报道，Beard 在 ZZ Top 发行首张单曲 Salt Lick 后加入了该乐队，随后聘请 Hill 担任贝斯手。 据《滚石》报道，他是乐队的节奏鼓手，主唱了《La Grange》、《Tush》和《Cheap Sunglasses》等热门歌曲。 乐队表示，尽管他的姓氏如此，但他还是被称为“无胡子男人”，因为他是休斯顿乐团中唯一没有留着长胡子的成员，该乐队因长胡子而闻名。 该乐队 1984 年著名的专辑《Eliminator》收录了热门歌曲《Gimme All Your Lovin》、《Sharp Dressed Man》和《Legs》。该专辑销量超过 1000 万张，并于 1996 年获得美国唱片业协会 (RIAA) 的钻石级外部认证。该专辑还获得了格莱美奖提名。 1987 年，乐队凭借《Afterburner》专辑再次获得录音学院颁发的格莱美奖。 2021 年，该乐队还凭借 Sam Dunn 的纪录片《That Little Ol' Band From Texas》获得最佳音乐电影提名。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The Indian activist jailed after taking on a luxury hotel plan
title.zh: 印度活动人士因参与豪华酒店计划而被判入狱

summary.en: An activist's detention has brought under focus a larger battle over land and development around the famed Kaziranga National Park.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On 30 July, the day Pranab Doley was set to be released from jail, his father and lawyer arrived at the prison in the northeastern Indian state of Assam to take the activist home.

Doley, 40, had been arrested weeks earlier after joining a June protest against a proposed luxury hotel near Kaziranga National Park, a Unesco World Heritage Site whose grasslands, wetlands and forests are home to elephants, tigers and the world's largest population of one-horned rhinos.

A court had granted him and four others bail on 29 July. But the Assam government invoked the National Security Act, a sweeping law that allows authorities to detain people for extended periods without trial, and his release was denied.

The government's grounds for detaining him, set out in an order seen by the BBC, draw on nearly a decade of allegations against Doley. It cites 13 criminal cases registered since 2017 and describes a pattern of unlawful assembly, intimidation, obstruction and violence. It also alleges suspicious foreign transactions and questions the source of funds for a series of overseas trips.

These charges sparked anger, with critics accusing the government of using a draconian law to scupper a protest against the hotel project.

His lawyer Mrityunjoy Pegu said most of the older cases had been resolved and that only two were pending before Doley's latest arrest - which he had declared in his affidavit when he contested unsuccessfully as an independent candidate in this year's state election.

"He is an activist who fights for people's rights," Pegu told the BBC. "That is why the police had registered some cases against him."

Doley's case has drawn attention to the protest he took part in - and led to a wider debate over land, conservation and development around Kaziranga.

Officials say the new five-star hotel, to be built across 10 acres, will bring investment, jobs and wealthier tourists to Kaziranga. But dozens of families say they are being displaced from land they have cultivated for generations.

The district administration says the land being used for the project is owned by the government.

Deputy Commissioner Biswajit Phukan told the BBC that most protesting families have land registered in their names or those of their ancestors, which has not been taken for the project.

"It is not disputed that some persons may have been cultivating or otherwise using portions of the [project] land. However, the land parcel in question was never allotted or settled in the names of the persons who are presently protesting against the project," he said.

Authorities, he said, had provided financial assistance and land to eligible residents after verification, and promised job skills training to help locals find work.

title.en: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, court hears
title.zh: 法庭获悉，Meta 在 Facebook 和 Instagram 上吸引了儿童

summary.en: Meta argued social media addiction does not exist, as a trial stemming from a major lawsuit brought by US states got under way.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A court has heard claims Meta intentionally hooked a generation of children on Facebook and Instagram, as the biggest legal challenge the social media platform has faced began on Tuesday.

A jury in Oakland, California will spend the next six weeks wading through claims by top attorneys from several US states, and lawyers for the social media company, that at turns rebutted the other as the trial opened.

A lawyer for California claimed Meta found "millions" of 11 and 12-year-olds were on Instagram and "it did little to keep them off".

Meta's representative said just over 100,000 such users were found, and also argued that social media addiction does not exist.

The trial stems from a lawsuit filed in 2023 by 29 US states, including California and New York, in which they claim numerous violations of federal and state privacy laws for children.

Not only are the states seeking billions of dollars from Meta, they are demanding it make changes to Instagram and Facebook , including ending "like" counts and infinite scroll.

Paul Schmidt, a lead attorney for Meta in the trial, directly addressed an internal research report that Megan O'Neill, a lead attorney for California, made part of the states' opening arguments.

The Meta document O'Neill showed the jury found that "1 in 5 teens says Instagram makes them feel worse".

"What else does the document say?" Schmidt went on. "That 41% of teens said it made them feel better and another 41% said it had no effect."

Schmidt also worked to poke holes in the states' argument that Meta had not only failed to stop users under the age of 13 from using its platforms, but that it intentionally "hooked" teens and children as users of Facebook and Instagram, or that they were designed to be addictive.

As for Meta being able to verify the age of every user on its platform, Schmidt argued that the very privacy laws Meta was being accused of violating in the case prevent it from saving and using the data it would need to effectively track underage users.

When it comes to addiction, Schmidt argued a point that Meta has put forward in at other litigation this year: that social media addiction does not exist.

"There can be no dispute that Meta has recognised people struggle, or can struggle, with their use of social media, and has come up with tools to try and address that," Schmidt said.

Yet, he pointed to past statements from chief executive Mark Zuckerberg and head of Instagram Adam Mosseri that not only were Facebook and Instagram not designed to be addictive, scientific research has not yet come to support the idea that an addiction to social media is possible.

body.zh: 法院已听取了有关 Meta 故意让一代儿童沉迷 Facebook 和 Instagram 的指控，该社交媒体平台面临的最大法律挑战于周二开始。 加利福尼亚州奥克兰的陪审团将在接下来的六周时间里仔细审查来自美国几个州的顶级律师和这家社交媒体公司的律师的主张，在审判开始时，他们轮流反驳对方的主张。 加利福尼亚州的一名律师声称，Meta 发现“数百万”11 岁和 12 岁的孩子在使用 Instagram，“这并没有阻止他们”。 Meta 的代表表示，已发现此类用户超过 10 万，并认为社交媒体成瘾并不存在。 该审判源于 2023 年美国 29 个州（包括加利福尼亚州和纽约州）提起的诉讼，他们在诉讼中声称存在大量违反联邦和州儿童隐私法的行为。 各州不仅向 Meta 寻求数十亿美元的资金，还要求其对 Instagram 和 Facebook 做出改变，包括结束“点赞”计数和无限滚动。 Meta 在审判中的首席律师保罗·施密特 (Paul Schmidt) 直接谈到了一份内部研究报告，该报告称加州首席律师梅根·奥尼尔 (Megan O'Neill) 参与了各州开庭陈词的一部分。 奥尼尔向陪审团展示的元文件显示，“五分之一的青少年表示 Instagram 让他们感觉更糟”。 “文件上还说了什么？”施密特继续说道。 “41% 的青少年表示这让他们感觉更好，另外 41% 的青少年表示没有效果。” 施密特还努力揭穿各州的论点，即 Meta 不仅未能阻止 13 岁以下的用户使用其平台，而且还故意“吸引”青少年和儿童成为 Facebook 和 Instagram 的用户，或者他们的设计就是为了让他们上瘾。 至于 Meta 能够验证其平台上每个用户的年龄，施密特辩称，Meta 在本案中被指控违反的隐私法使其无法保存和使用有效跟踪未成年用户所需的数据。 当谈到成瘾问题时，施密特提出了 Meta 在今年其他诉讼中提出的一个观点：社交媒体成瘾并不存在。 施密特说：“毫无疑问，Meta 已经认识到人们在使用社交媒体时遇到困难，或者可能会遇到困难，并且已经想出了一些工具来尝试解决这个问题。” 然而，他指出首席执行官马克·扎克伯格和 Instagram 负责人 Adam Mosseri 过去的声明称，Facebook 和 Instagram 不仅不是为了让人上瘾，科学研究还没有支持社交媒体上瘾的可能性。 她严重依赖 Meta 提供的数百万份文档中的信息，包括内部研究、员工电子邮件和聊天记录……

title.en: Minors living alone on Ceuta's streets at risk of abuse
title.zh: 独居休达街头的未成年人面临虐待风险

summary.en: Several thousand unaccompanied minors have gathered in Ceuta, a Spanish enclave on the northern coast of Africa. Illness and abuse are rife, and the authorities admit they are overwhelmed.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Several thousand unaccompanied minors have gathered in Ceuta, a Spanish enclave on the northern coast of Africa. Illness and abuse are rife, and the authorities admit they are overwhelmed.

It's 8 a.m. at the Tarajal industrial park in the autonomous city of Ceuta. But there are no workers and truck drivers to be seen near the warehouses today. Instead, there are makeshift tents, some of them made out of cardboard, with mainly children and teenagers sleeping under dirty blankets.

According to certain estimates, there could be between 3,000 and 5,000 unaccompanied minors in Ceuta. Some are living on the streets because they cannot find a spot in one of the already overcrowded reception facilities in the enclave.

Amina (not her real name), a 14-year-old Moroccan girl, and her brother were among the 80,000 people who crossed the border into Spain from Morocco in late July. Though most of these have since left Ceuta , some 9,000 remain, according to the local authorities — and many are minors. "

What's worst is that we don't have toilets," said Amina. "We have to go somewhere in the bushes, but I don't dare go alone."

Close by is a Moroccan woman called Malika (also not her real name) who has spread out several blankets for herself and her four children. She told DW she was not making enough as a cleaning lady in Morocco , adding that she earned the equivalent of €7 ($8) per day.

"That's just not enough to provide for everyone," she said. "School will start again soon, and I don't have any money for books, nor even decent clothes for the children."

That's why she decided to take part in the mass crossing of the Spanish border last month when she read about it on social media. But now she doesn't know what to do.

"One child got sick. He had a high fever, but I couldn't get help anywhere," she said. In the end, she made compresses with water and vinegar to see if that would help.

But now she is particularly worried about her 12-and 14-year-old daughters, because the number of sexual assaults has risen sharply in the past week. Police are currently investigating at least 15 suspected cases of rape. The local authorities suspect the actual number of cases to be much higher.

Susana Ascaso, an emergency doctor at Ceuta University Hospital, said she had treated several young girls in recent days.

"Just yesterday, another 12-year-old came to the emergency room," she said. "She said that other migrants had harassed her and touched her inappropriately. She arrived here completely terrified and in tears. She was with a woman who had found her on the street. That woman saved the girl."

body.zh: 数千名无人陪伴的未成年人聚集在非洲北海岸的西班牙飞地休达。疾病和虐待盛行，当局承认他们不知所措。 上午 8 点，位于休达自治市的塔拉哈尔工业园区。但今天仓库附近没有看到工人和卡车司机。相反，有临时帐篷，其中一些是用纸板制成的，主要是儿童和青少年睡在肮脏的毯子下。 据估计，休达可能有 3,000 至 5,000 名无人陪伴的未成年人。有些人流落街头，因为他们在飞地已经人满为患的接待设施中找不到一席之地。 阿米娜（化名）是一名 14 岁的摩洛哥女孩，她和她的兄弟是 7 月底从摩洛哥越过边境进入西班牙的 8 万人中的一员。据当地政府称，尽管其中大多数人已经离开休达，但仍有约 9,000 人留下，其中许多人是未成年人。 ” 最糟糕的是我们没有厕所，”阿米娜说。 “我们必须去灌木丛里的某个地方，但我不敢一个人去。” 附近是一位名叫马利卡（Malika）（也不是她的真名）的摩洛哥妇女，她为自己和四个孩子铺好了几条毯子。她告诉德国之声，她在摩洛哥做清洁工赚的钱不够多，并补充说她每天的收入相当于 7 欧元（8 美元）。 “这还不足以养活所有人，”她说。 “学校马上就要开学了，我没有钱买书，甚至没有钱给孩子们穿像样的衣服。” 这就是为什么她上个月在社交媒体上看到有关大规模穿越西班牙边境的报道后决定参加这一活动。但现在她不知道该怎么办。 “一个孩子生病了。他发高烧，但我无法在任何地方获得帮助，”她说。最后，她用水和醋做了敷布，看看是否有帮助。 但现在她特别担心自己12岁和14岁的女儿，因为过去一周性侵犯的数量急剧上升。警方目前正在调查至少15起疑似强奸案。地方当局怀疑实际病例数要高得多。 休达大学医院的急诊医生苏珊娜·阿斯卡索说，她最近几天治疗了几名年轻女孩。 “就在昨天，另一名 12 岁的孩子来到急诊室，”她说。 “她说其他移民骚扰了她，并对她进行了不恰当的触摸。她到达这里时非常害怕，流着泪。她和一名在街上发现她的妇女在一起。那个妇女救了这个女孩。” 阿斯卡索表示，对于“18 岁以下的女孩”来说，情况尤其困难，她们“尤其面临风险”。她补充说，存在着严重的不平衡……

title.en: Afghanistan: Only 5% of labor market are women under Taliban
title.zh: 阿富汗：塔利班统治下女性仅占劳动力市场的 5%

summary.en: The International Labour Organization estimates that only 5.1% of workers in Afghanistan are women, five years after the Taliban's return to power. That's less than a third of the proportion in 2019 and 2020.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 国际劳工组织估计，塔利班重新掌权五年后，阿富汗工人中只有 5.1% 是女性。这还不到 2019 年和 2020 年比例的三分之一。 根据国际劳工组织 (ILO) 周二发布的一份报告，自塔利班重新掌权以来的五年里，阿富汗劳动力市场中女性的比例已下降至每 20 人中就有 1 人左右。 国际劳工组织写道：“在妇女接受教育和就业的机会受到严格限制的背景下，阿富汗的女性劳动力参与率预计在全球第二低，到 2026 年仅为 5.1%。” 它呼吁采取紧急措施应对妇女的“严重排斥”，并表示这对于增强阿富汗经济的整体弹性至关重要。 随着美国和其他北约部队撤军，塔利班于 2021 年 8 月迅速重新掌权，结束了妇女在多年的伊斯兰强硬统治后享有相对改善的经济和教育自由的 20 年时期。 该联合国组织警告说，自 2021 年以来，劳动力市场将发生“重大的人口和制度变化”，其中许多变化使女性处于不利地位。 国际劳工组织阿富汗办事处主任兼高级协调员蒂特·哈比亚卡雷 (Tite Habiyakare) 表示：“在如此大比例的人口仍被排除在经济活动之外的情况下，阿富汗无法建立一个有弹性的劳动力市场。” 报告称，塔利班接管五年后，阿富汗劳动力市场仍“承受相当大的压力”，仅从 2021 年的崩溃中略有恢复。 当塔利班在新冠病毒大流行期间卷土重来以及西方军队和资金外流时，阿富汗的 GDP 下降了约 15%。 2022 年，该数字仍深陷负值区域，此后才勉强进入正增长区域，远未恢复到塔利班之前的水平。 从绝对值来看，就业人数已经开始上升，但速度还不够快，无法跟上人口增长的速度——无论是国内人口还是移民回国造成的——这意味着工作人口的比例正趋于平稳，仅占总人口的不到三分之一。 该文件还呼吁增加对代表性劳动力数据收集的投资，并警告说，其数据依赖于模型估计，而模型估计“存在相当大的不确定性，应谨慎解释”。 报告称，移民，特别是来自伊朗和巴基斯坦的移民的大规模回返，已成为“阿富汗面临的劳动力市场的决定性挑战之一”。 2023年至今年5月底，已有超过600万阿富汗人从伊朗和巴基斯坦返回...

title.en: Should India be worried about the Mecca defense pact?
title.zh: 印度是否应该担忧麦加防务协议？

summary.en: A new defense agreement between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey is integrating Pakistan more deeply into the Middle East's security framework. This development raises questions about how India will react to the evolving geopolitical landscape.
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦、沙特阿拉伯和土耳其之间的一项新防务协议，使巴基斯坦更深入地融入中东的安全架构。这一发展引发了人们对印度将如何应对不断变化的地区局势的疑问。

body.en:
A defense agreement between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey brings Islamabad deeper into the security architecture of the Middle East. How is India planning to respond?

The "Mecca Joint Defense Agreement" signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan on August 7, comes amid the Iran war and shifting security arrangements in the Middle East.

Saudi Arabia is seeking additional security partnerships as it faces uncertainty over the reliability of the US security umbrella. Turkey is seeking a larger regional role, while Pakistan is looking to turn its longstanding military relationship with Riyadh into wider strategic influence.

The agreement calls for collective defense, stating an armed attack on one member will be regarded as an attack on all three.

It also formalizes relationships that already exist . Pakistan has trained and assisted Saudi forces for decades, while its defense relationship with Turkey has expanded through military exchanges and cooperation.

For India , the question is whether the pact gives archrival Pakistan a deeper role in a region central to Indian interests.

Some Indian analysts see little immediate change in the regional balance. Others see a warning that India needs a stronger security presence in a region where its economic interests have grown considerably.

Saudi Arabia is a major energy and investment partner for New Delhi. The Gulf and the Red Sea are vital to India's trade and energy security.

The pact allows Pakistan to expand on its security role in the Gulf while providing an institutional framework for closer defense cooperation and potentially greater access to funding and technology.

However, former Indian High Commissioner to Pakistan Ajay Bisaria believes the agreement will have little effect on the basic dynamics of an India Pakistan confrontation.

"It does little to move the needle beyond the Saudi-Pakistan defense pact of last year, an arrangement that proved to have only signaling value for Iran, the US and Israel, at a moment when Riyadh was unsettled by the frailty of the American security umbrella," he added.

In the event of a future India-Pakistan crisis, the former ambassador said he does not expect the pact to fundamentally alter Saudi Arabia's position.

"For India, this is a pact to be monitored, not one to be unduly concerned about," Bisaria said.

"In the event of another terrorist attack from Pakistan, the situation is unlikely to look very different from Operation Sindoor, save, perhaps, for some added rhetoric," he said, referring to the name of India's response to a 2025 attack on tourists in Kashmir that New Delhi has blamed on Pakistan-backed militants . title.en: Designed to 'exploit' children: Meta faces a historic courtroom reckoning

summary.en: The trial's outcome could help reshape Facebook and Instagram, and leave Meta with billions of dollars to pay in penalties.

body.en:
Meta knowingly hooked and exploited children, a United States federal court has heard in the trial of the social media giant on charges that it deliberately made Instagram and Facebook addictive to young users.

In what many experts have called social media's "big tobacco moment," a coalition of US states is demanding Meta pay US$200 billion ($282 billion) in penalties for using technology specifically designed to foster addiction among children in a similar fashion to cigarettes.

Meta "exploited how kids' brains work," California prosecutor Megan O'Neill said in opening arguments, painting Meta's business model as one built to "hook the users, hold them for as long as they can, harvest their data, and then hide the truth from the public".

"It worked especially well for kids," O'Neill added. "Meta needed kids, and it needed to reassure the people who cared about those kids that the kids are safe."

Meta's lawyer, Paul Schmidt, acknowledged that some users were harmed by the networks, but argued that the company had "tried to come up with tools to help them". He argued research showed no clear link between adolescents' social media use and a lack of well-being.

He also said Mark Zuckerberg, Meta's co-founder and CEO, shared the company's desire to improve its services, and not make them dangerous.

"They don't believe they're going to do well if people don't like their service," Schmidt said.

Before the trial began, the company denied all the allegations, insisting it had worked with parents, experts and law enforcement to incorporate protective safeguards for children.

This is not the first case seeking to hold tech companies — including Meta — accountable for these types of issues, but it could become one of the most consequential if it leads to sweeping changes on the platforms.

Meta founder and chief Mark Zuckerberg is among the star witnesses expected to testify, along with Instagram head Adam Mosseri.

Activists, including mothers of children they say were driven to suicide by their social media usage, rallied outside court.

One mother, Lori Schott, called out Zuckerberg and Mosseri, saying they "built one of those most powerful and richest companies in the world... But power does not excuse harm."

This is the first federal trial in what is expected to be a tidal wave of lawsuits also targeting TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube as families, educators and state governments charge them with harming the mental health of young people.

Meta, which has more than three billion users worldwide, is the sole defendant in this case.

title.en: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history leaves 2,300 dead in Congo

body.en:
The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s fast-moving Ebola outbreak has now killed over 2,300 people and become the deadliest outbreak of the disease on record in the Central African nation.

The outbreak unfolding in one of DRC's most vulnerable regions is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever, with 4,945 cases including 2,325 deaths, according to government data.

It's the DRC's 17th outbreak, with a toll that has eclipsed that of the country's 2018-2020 outbreak when 2,299 deaths out of 3,481 cases were recorded.

The latest data shows 101 new cases and 33 deaths reported in the previous 24 hours. Over 1,000 people have recovered, while 730 remain in hospitals or isolation.

The outbreak has infected and killed more people at a greater speed than any other outbreak in history. The World Health Organization has said it is on track to surpass the 2014-16 Ebola outbreak in West Africa, the deadliest on record with more than 11,000 deaths.

Trish Newport, emergency coordinator with Doctors Without Borders, said the limited community engagement in the outbreak remains a key challenge.

"The community needs to be aware about the outbreak," she told The Associated Press news agency, adding that people "need to be involved in the response, and they need to know what the signs and symptoms are and what to do if they get sick. And this today is not happening in every single place where there are Ebola cases".

Starting from the first confirmed case, the outbreak reached 2,000 killed almost three times faster than in the 2014-16 outbreak.

Some families have lost up to 15 of their relatives in the epicentre, the Ituri province, Newport said.

"We rapidly need to scale up to be able to prevent more deaths from happening, more families and communities from being impacted," she added.

There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the rare Bundibugyo virus responsible for the current outbreak across six provinces in Congo's east. Trials for those are ongoing in Ituri.

Most new cases and deaths are being reported outside of the people being monitored. Challenges facing medical teams dealing with the outbreak also include strikes by some unpaid health workers, threats by rebel groups, anger from long-traumatised communities, bad roads making it difficult to reach all the affected territories, and misinformation claiming that Ebola isn’t real.

The WHO warned over the weekend that the outbreak is still moving at an "exceptional pace" ahead of efforts to track it, noting that it reached a weekly record of 579 cases and 304 deaths in the previous week.

title.en: Iran to go 'full offensive' if diplomacy fails as Trump threatens to bomb Oman
title.zh: 伊朗称若外交失败将“全面进攻”，此前特朗普威胁轰炸阿曼

summary.en: Iran has stated it will go on a "full offensive" if diplomatic efforts fail, following threats from the US to bomb Oman. Meanwhile, Iran has been negotiating an agreement with Oman regarding the management of the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 在美国威胁轰炸阿曼之后，伊朗表示如果外交努力失败，将采取“全面攻势”。与此同时，伊朗一直在与邻国阿曼就霍尔木兹海峡的管理问题进行谈判。

body.en:
Iran will shift to a "fully offensive" military posture because efforts to negotiate a permanent end to its war with the United States have stalled, as the US ruled out extending a temporary ceasefire agreement.

Progress towards peace talks and a resumption of oil tanker traffic through the strategic Strait of Hormuz has ground to a halt, with no sign that the warring parties are moving towards ending the conflict that the US and Israel launched with attacks on Iran on 28 February.

"Iranian entities must be prepared to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and wider region, as Iran will be ready to make decisions and take action on difficult decisions," a senior Iranian official told Reuters news agency.

The official added that Iran would conduct a "timely and precise" military attack to break the US naval blockade if diplomacy failed.

Monday marked the day Iran and the US were expected to reach a final peace agreement under a memorandum of understanding signed in June aimed at ending the war.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Signed on 17 June, the MoU set a 60-day timeframe for the US and Iran to reach a broader deal on Iran's nuclear program and US sanctions.

The agreement, which declared the "immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts", quickly unravelled over a dispute about control of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway through which a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas flowed before the war.

Asked by reporters on Monday if the US was seeking to extend June's interim agreement, US President Donald Trump said no.

Iran said point 5 of the MoU gave it the right to manage the strait, which it shares with Oman, while the US rejected that interpretation. Hostilities resumed as Iran began firing on vessels it said were trying to sail through Hormuz on an unapproved route, and Trump said on 7 July that the pact was "over".

"Within the short period of a few weeks set by Iran, all the agreement's provisions must be implemented by the US. This is a precondition for further negotiations with the US," the Iranian official told Reuters, adding that mediators would share Iran's deadline with the US and regional countries.

title.en: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral

summary.en: While hailing Zhu’s legacy, authorities are wary that the nostalgia could lead to criticisms of Xi’s rule.

body.en:
Flags at government sites are flying at half-mast and security vehicles are parked in the heart of Beijing, as China mourns former Premier Zhu Rongji.

Zhu died of an illness last week at 97 and was cremated at a funeral in Beijing on Tuesday. The ceremony, attended by senior leaders including President Xi Jinping, was kept low-key. No footage has been released.

Zhu, who served as China's premier from 1998 to 2003, is remembered as one of the country's most important economic reformers.

While hailing the late premier as a "loyal" party member, the Chinese state is also wary that public mourning for his era of reform can easily turn into veiled criticisms of the current government under Xi.

Xi was among the leaders who had visited Zhu in hospital or sent condolences after his death, Chinese state media reported on Tuesday. Others included incumbent premier Li Qiang and ex-president Hu Jintao.

After his death, state media described Zhu as an "outstanding member of the Chinese Communist Party" and a "time-tested and loyal Communist fighter".

He was cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery, an exclusive resting place for high-ranking officials and other prominent figures.

Meanwhile, online, posts about Zhu have been contained and censored - including an essay written by economist Zhao Jian, which remembered Zhu's era as a time when people were "properly poor" but saw a clear future ahead.

"There were no smartphones then, no short-form videos and no screens filled by the purveyors of anxiety," he wrote.

"The sky was blue, life moved slowly and people could say what they really thought."

The party has long been fearful of public reaction to deaths of senior officials and public figures.

The deaths of former premier Zhou Enlai in 1976 and former CCP general secretary Hu Yaobang in 1989 prompted widespread outpourings of grief that morphed into protests.

Zhu died just days before the Communist Party leadership gathered to commemorate the birth centenary of President Jiang Zemin, who died in 2022.

The death of Zhu and Jiang, two prominent leaders from the same era, has prompted a wave of nostalgia among many Chinese people for a time when the country looked as if it was going in a different direction - when it appeared that it may open to the world and allow more freedom for its people.

Previously purged under Mao Zedong's regime, Zhu was brought back into the fold after Mao's death in 1976.

Zhu served as premier alongside Jiang Zemin, who became Communist Party chief in 1989 and president in 1993.

The two men served alongside each other at the top of China's leadership from 1998 to 2003, leading China through an era of rapid economic growth and entry into global trade.

body.en:
Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has drawn scrutiny.

On August 12, an Indonesian frigate briefly joined a naval exercise with China's People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) in waters off Taiwan's east coast, with Taipei asking Jakarta for a reason why it joined the drill.

Indonesian Navy frigate KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai joined the PLAN guided-missile frigate Honghe for what Jakarta described as a "passing exercise." The maneuvers took place during Taiwan's annual Han Kuang military drill. 

An Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson said they were fully aware that the exercise's location "made it particularly sensitive," but stressed that its vessel's presence "was simply part of its transit route back to Indonesia." According to the Taipei Times , the Indonesian vessel was returning from Vladivostok, Russia after an exercise with the Russian navy.  

Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council condemned Beijing's "provocation" after China announced the drill on August 11. Taipei also requested "further details from the Indonesian government" from its Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  

Beijing considers Taiwan to be Chinese territory and has vowed to "reunite" the self-ruled island with the mainland, by using force if necessary . The People's Liberation Army has ratcheted up pressure on Taiwan with frequent military exercises around the island, especially since former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei in 2022.

Amid reactions from Taipei and Washington, the Indonesian Navy stated that its activities with the Chinese Navy were "not warfighting activities in nature" and "not intended as combat training."

Ying-Yu Lin, an associate professor at Taiwan's Tamkang University Graduate Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Studies, told DW that the Chinese exercise with Indonesia had little tactical significance.

"It wasn't as practical as a joint maritime drill, but China wanted to claim its capability in the waters," he said.

"Like it or not, Indonesia is now dragged into this kind of geopolitical gambit," she said.

Kabinawa added that passing exercises were among the lowest-level naval activities yet used by China to justify its intimidation of Taiwan.

"Indonesia must also exercise caution in this regard," she said, adding that Jakarta should "not to be too naive," to assume that its participation in a "regular exercise" with China would not cause concern in...
body.zh: 印度尼西亚维持不结盟的外交政策，但雅加达有限地参与与中国海军在台湾附近举行的低级别海军演习，引起了密切关注。 8月12日，一艘印度尼西亚护卫舰短暂参加了与中国人民解放军海军在台湾东海岸附近海域举行的海军演习，台北向雅加达询问其参加演习的原因。 印度尼西亚海军护卫舰 KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai 与中国海军导弹护卫舰红河号一起进行了雅加达所说的“穿越演习”。这次演习是在台湾一年一度的汉光军演期间进行的。 印度尼西亚外交部发言人表示，他们完全意识到演习地点“使其特别敏感”，但强调其船只的存在“只是其返回印度尼西亚的过境路线的一部分”。据《台北时报》报道，这艘印尼舰艇在与俄罗斯海军演习后正从俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克返回。 中国8月11日宣布演习后，台湾陆委会谴责北京的“挑衅”。台北还要求外交部“提供更多细节”。 北京认为台湾是中国领土，并誓言要让这个自治岛屿与大陆“统一”，必要时会使用武力。特别是自美国前众议院议长南希·佩洛西 2022 年访问台北以来，解放军在台湾频繁进行军事演习，加大了对台湾的压力。 在台北和华盛顿的反应中，印度尼西亚海军表示，其与中国海军的活动“本质上不是战斗活动”，并且“无意进行战斗训练”。 台湾淡江大学国际事务与战略研究所副教授林英宇告诉德国之声，中国与印尼的演习没有什么战术意义。 他说：“这不像联合海上演习那么实际，但中国希望宣示其在该海域的能力。” 不过，日本国际问题研究所研究台印尼关系的客座研究员拉蒂·卡比纳瓦(Ratih Kabinawa)告诉德国之声，无论演习的意义如何，印尼都应该预料到台湾会做出一些反应。 “无论你喜欢与否，印度尼西亚现在都被拖入了这种地缘政治游戏，”她说。 卡比纳瓦补充说，此次演习是中国迄今为止用来证明其恐吓台湾合理性的最低级别的海军活动之一。 她说：“印度尼西亚在这方面也必须保持谨慎。”她补充说，雅加达应该“不要太天真”，认为参加与中国的“定期演习”不会引起人们的担忧……

reflection.en: In a world of complex geopolitical dynamics, nations often strive to maintain peace and neutrality. Indonesia's efforts to navigate its foreign policy amidst regional tensions reflect the ongoing challenge of living at peace with all, as far as it depends on them. This pursuit requires wisdom and a steadfast commitment to de-escalation and understanding.
reflection.zh: 在复杂的地缘政治格局中，各国常努力维持和平与中立。印度尼西亚在区域紧张局势中努力调整其外交政策，反映了在力所能及的范围内与所有人和平相处的持续挑战。这种追求需要智慧和对缓和局势、增进理解的坚定承诺。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: After Hormuz, China looks to the promise – and peril – of the Arctic’s ‘ice silk road’
title.zh: 继霍尔木兹海峡之后，中国着眼于北极“冰上丝绸之路”的机遇与风险

summary.en: China has initiated the first regular shipping transits through the Arctic's northern sea route, aiming to establish an "ice silk road." This new maritime path, however, raises significant concerns regarding its potential environmental impact and geopolitical implications.
summary.zh: 中国已开通北极航线的首次定期运输，旨在建立一条“冰上丝绸之路”。然而，这条新的海上航线在环境影响和地缘政治方面引发了重大担忧。

body.en: China has established the first scheduled transit through the northern sea route, but questions remain over the environmental and political risks When Marco Rubio suggested that the world should look to new shipping lanes to bypass the logjammed strait of Hormuz, it’s unlikely he had the Arctic’s northern sea route in mind. And yet in recent months the promise of this 5,500km channel – cleaved through frozen seas by nuclear-powered icebreakers and illuminated by a sun that never dips below the Arctic horizon – has grown. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国已经建立了第一条通过北方海路的定期过境航线，但环境和政治风险仍然存在问题。当马可·卢比奥建议世界应该寻求新的航道以绕过堵塞的霍尔木兹海峡时，他不太可能想到北极的北方海路。然而近几个月来，这条 5,500 公里长的航道 — — 由核动力破冰船劈开冰冻的海洋，并由永远不会低于北极地平线的太阳照亮 — — 的前景越来越大。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of new trade routes like the Arctic's "ice silk road" highlights humanity's drive for progress and efficiency. Yet, as the story notes, such ventures also carry significant environmental and political risks that demand careful consideration. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to foresee danger and take precautions, rather than rushing headlong into...
reflection.zh: 像北极“冰上丝绸之路”这样的新贸易路线的开辟，彰显了人类对进步和效率的追求。然而，正如报道所指出的，此类项目也伴随着重大的环境和政治风险，需要我们审慎考量。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们预见危险并采取预防措施，而不是为了短期利益而贸然陷入潜在的危机。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站与大量简历：澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: An Australian firm has been caught up in an FBI investigation into alleged Chinese espionage, involving a fake consultancy website that impersonated the Brisbane company. This fake site was among 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice.
summary.zh: 一家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查，其中涉及一个冒充这家布里斯班公司的虚假咨询网站。这个虚假网站是美国司法部查获的13个网站之一。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被忽略。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights how deception, even when elaborately crafted, often has a limited lifespan. While falsehoods may initially mislead, their true nature is eventually revealed, as seen in the seizure of these fake websites. Yahweh's word reminds us that truth ultimately prevails, and deceit cannot endure indefinitely.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了欺骗，即使精心策划，也往往寿命有限。虚假信息可能一时蒙蔽，但其真实面目终将被揭露，正如这些虚假网站被查获一样。雅伟的话语提醒我们，真理最终会得胜，谎言无法永远持续。

verse.textEn: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verse.textZh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。

title.en: How to buy a ‘mega-dinghy’: the perilous new model of Channel crossing
title.zh: 如何购买“巨型橡皮艇”：危险的英吉利海峡偷渡新模式

summary.en: The Guardian China reports on the alarming trend of large dinghies, capable of carrying hundreds, being used for perilous Channel crossings. The article investigates the supply chain for these vessels, noting that large orders are readily fulfilled by manufacturers.
summary.zh: 《卫报》中国版报道称，载有数百人的大型充气艇被用于危险的英吉利海峡偷渡，这一趋势令人担忧。文章调查了这些大型船只的来源，指出制造商可以轻松满足大批量订单。

body.en: Boats carrying hundreds of people are a clear and alarming trend. But where do such large vessels come from? Providing a large dinghy for use in the choppy seas of western Europe was not a problem, as long as the order was for more than 20 vessels, they said. The sales manager at the Chinese company even had an online brochure for an undercover Guardian reporter, posing as a prospective client, to peruse. They had a production capacity of 500 boats a month and, yes, it was possible to get even bigger ones for the right price. They could do a seven or even an eight-metre military-style dinghy for $1,678 (£1,238) a boat, without the engines, but that would be lacking CE certification, the mandatory mark that shows a product meets EU health and safety requirements. Additional reporting by Lyndon Li Continue reading...
body.zh: 载有数百人的船只是一个明显且令人震惊的趋势。但这么大的船只从哪里来呢？他们表示，只要订单超过 20 艘，提供一艘在西欧波涛汹涌的海域使用的大型小艇就不成问题。这家中国公司的销售经理甚至还为一位冒充潜在客户的卫报卧底记者准备了一份在线手册供其细读。他们的生产能力为每月 500 艘船，是的，有可能以合适的价格获得更大的船。他们可以以每艘 1,678 美元（1,238 英镑）的价格制造一艘七米甚至八米长的军用小艇，不带发动机，但这将缺乏 CE 认证，这是表明产品符合欧盟健康和安全要求的强制性标志。林登·李的补充报道继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on the supply of vessels for perilous journeys reminds us of the vulnerable individuals seeking safety and new beginnings. Yahweh calls us to recognize His presence in those who are marginalized and in desperate need. Our compassion for 'the least of these' reflects our love for Him.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于用于危险旅程的船只供应的报道，提醒我们那些寻求安全和新生活的弱势个体。雅伟呼召我们要在那些被边缘化和极度需要的人身上认出祂的存在。我们对“这些最小的弟兄”的怜悯，反映了我们对祂的爱。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The Fauci hearing was painful to watch. But we need answers on Covid-19’s origin| David Relman
title.zh: 福奇听证会令人痛苦，但我们需要新冠病毒起源的答案 | 大卫·雷尔曼

summary.en: Despite recent congressional hearings, understanding the origin of Covid-19 remains elusive, with a microbiologist observing a deterioration in public discourse surrounding the issue.
summary.zh: 尽管近期国会举行了听证会，但了解新冠病毒的起源仍然困难重重，一位微生物学家指出，围绕这一问题的公共讨论正在恶化。

body.en: Despite the recent hearings in Congress, we seem to be even further from the goal of understanding Covid-19’s origin’s than we have ever been As a microbiologist and infectious disease clinician, it has been tough to watch the recent devolution of public discourse on Covid-19 origins. It has been especially difficult for me to read the comments of Anthony Fauci about the origins debate in his now-public diary . And it has been painful to watch the televised spectacle hosted by the US senator Rand Paul on 29 July involving a hostile interrogation of Fauci. Despite many early pleas, including my own , for a dispassionate, objective assessment of what we know, don’t know and need to know about Covid-19 origins, we seem to be even further from this goal now than we have ever been – plagued by politicization, polarization and illogical thinking. David Relman is a professor of medicine and microbiology at Stanford University. He was an inaugural member of the US National Science Advisory Board for Biosecurity and president of the Infectious Diseases Society of America Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管最近在国会举行了听证会，但我们似乎距离了解 Covid-19 起源的目标比以往任何时候都更远。作为一名微生物学家和传染病临床医生，很难看到最近公众关于 Covid-19 起源的讨论的转移。对我来说，阅读安东尼·福奇在他现已公开的日记中关于起源争论的评论尤其困难。 7 月 29 日美国参议员兰德·保罗主持的电视节目对福奇进行敌意审讯，令人感到痛苦。尽管包括我自己在内的许多人早期呼吁对我们所知道、不知道和需要了解的 Covid-19 起源进行冷静、客观的评估，但我们现在似乎比以往任何时候都离这个目标更远——受到政治化、两极分化和不合逻辑思维的困扰。大卫·雷尔曼是斯坦福大学医学和微生物学教授。他是美国国家生物安全科学咨询委员会的首任成员和美国传染病学会主席继续阅读...

reflection.en: The struggle to understand complex issues like the origin of Covid-19, especially amidst contentious public discourse, reminds us of the wisdom in seeking thorough examination. Proverbs 18:17 suggests that true understanding emerges only after hearing all sides and carefully scrutinizing every claim. This calls for patience and a commitment to truth beyond...
reflection.zh: 在围绕新冠病毒起源等复杂问题展开的激烈公共讨论中，我们努力寻求理解，这提醒我们彻底审查的重要性。箴言18:17指出，真正的理解只有在听取各方意见并仔细审查每项主张之后才能浮现。这要求我们超越初步印象，以耐心和对真理的承诺，从而走向更清晰的道路。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘TikTok wouldn’t open at all’: Taiwan simulates an internet blackout, with an eye on China threat
title.zh: “抖音完全打不开”：台湾模拟互联网中断，以应对中国威胁

summary.en: Taiwan conducted its first internet blackout simulation, prompted by concerns over the security of its undersea cables, which are vital for its digital connectivity. During the exercise in Taipei, air raid sirens sounded, mobile alerts pinged, and police directed people off the streets.
summary.zh: 台湾周四首次进行互联网中断模拟演习，原因是担心作为其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全。在台北的演习中，防空警报响起，手机警报提示音不断，警察引导人们离开街道。

body.en: Taiwan practised cutting off internet for the first time amid concerns about the safety of the undersea cables that form its ‘digital lifeline’ In Taipei, the streets swiftly empty as air raid sirens ring out and alerts ping on mobile phones. Police officers usher any stragglers into shelters, leaving the capital suddenly deserted. In cities across Taiwan, these kinds of drills are a fact of life every year , amid the growing threat posed by China across the strait, but this time there is something different. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于担心构成其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全性，台湾周四首次练习切断互联网。在台北，随着空袭警报的响起和手机上的警报声，街道迅速空无一人。警察把掉队的人带进避难所，首都突然变得空无一人。在台湾各城市，随着海峡两岸中国构成的威胁日益加剧，此类演习每年都是家常便饭，但这次有所不同。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Taiwan's simulation of an internet blackout highlights the deep anxieties nations face regarding critical infrastructure and potential threats. In moments of such vulnerability and preparation, the ancient promise of Yahweh reminds us not to fear or be dismayed, for divine presence offers strength and help. This spiritual anchor can guide communities as...
reflection.zh: 台湾模拟互联网中断，凸显了各国在关键基础设施和潜在威胁面前的深层焦虑。在面对这种脆弱和准备的时刻，雅伟的古老应许提醒我们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为神圣的同在提供力量和帮助。这个属灵的锚点可以指引社群应对复杂的挑战并建立韧性。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

body.en: Meanwhile Liberal MP Andrew Wallace says concerns remain over gambling bill after crossing the floor on Tuesday. Follow today’s news live Follow our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ‘Collapsing confidence’ in housing market, Wilson says Tim Wilson has jumped on that reporting around rent increases and says there has been a collapse in confidence since the budget which is hurting renters. We’ve had, since the budget, collapsing confidence, a lack of will to invest in housing that is going to be available for rentals. We’re seeing a complete disaster in the housing market, and we know that’s only going to do one thing while the government continues to overshoot its migration target, and that is an increase in rents on Australians struggling to save a first home deposit. There is an awful lot that goes into determining rents in Australia, and the thing that Treasury modelled in the context of the budget, what is the isolated effect of what the government actually changed about the housing market. And if I just step back for a second, we’ve got a broken housing system in our country, and it’s the renters of Australia who are bearing the brunt of really 40 years of government’s not doing enough about this problem. I think that Clare sadly needs to start taking a bit of responsibility for her housing policy. But also, Clare, stop gaslighting Australians, stop gaslighting the mum and dads who are currently watching this show and feeling the impact of your toxic housing taxes … She can sit on your show and defend her policies, but the evidence on the ground, the evidence from the experts, is that Labor’s toxic housing taxes are smashing the market. Continue reading...
body.zh: 与此同时，自由党议员安德鲁·华莱士(Andrew Wallace)表示，周二投票后，人们对赌博法案的担忧仍然存在。威尔逊表示，蒂姆·威尔逊已经对有关租金上涨的报道进行了报道，并表示自预算案以来，信心已经崩溃，这对租房者造成了伤害。自预算案发布以来，我们的信心一直在崩溃，缺乏投资可供出租的住房的意愿。我们看到房地产市场发生了一场彻底的灾难，我们知道，当政府继续超额完成其移民目标时，这只会做一件事，那就是增加努力节省首套房押金的澳大利亚人的租金。确定澳大利亚的租金需要考虑很多因素，财政部在预算背景下建模的内容是政府对房地产市场的实际改变的孤立影响是什么。如果我退后一步，我们国家的住房体系支离破碎，而澳大利亚的租房者首当其冲，因为 40 年来政府在这个问题上没有采取足够的措施。我认为克莱尔不幸地需要开始为她的住房政策承担一些责任。而且，克莱尔，别再对澳大利亚人施以煤气灯，别再对那些正在观看这个节目并感受到你们有毒住房税影响的爸爸妈妈们了……她可以坐在你们的节目上，为她的政策辩护，但来自专家的证据表明，工党的有毒住房税正在摧毁市场。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Labor reveals super increase position amid 'predatory' practices crackdown

summary.en: The government has drawn a line on compulsory superannuation as it unveils tougher consumer protections.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Labor will not increase how much superannuation employers must pay workers, instead focusing on reforms to stamp out "predatory" practices used to lure people to put retirement savings into risky investments.

The superannuation guarantee rate — the minimum percentage of a worker's earnings that employers must pay into a retirement fund — is 12 per cent, and there have been calls within Labor to raise the rate to 15 per cent.

While rebuffing the need to increase the guarantee rate, the government is doubling down on its defence of the superannuation system amid calls from One Nation to allow workers to withdraw funds before retirement to help pay off mortgages.

"There's no plans to lift the super guarantee," Assistant Treasurer Daniel Mulino, who will unveil the long-awaited consumer protection reforms later on Wednesday, told ABC's Radio National.

He said raising the rate to 12 per cent was something Labor had long pushed for and that was now "putting people in a very strong position" for retirement.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Mulino will detail the long-awaited crackdown on predatory practices in an address to the National Press Club on Wednesday, after the high-profile collapses of First Guardian and Shield Master Funds in 2024 and 2025 stripped an estimated 12,000 Australians of their retirement savings.

One Nation has pushed to loosen rules around early access, while the government ruled out any rise to the compulsory super guarantee on Wednesday morning.

The reforms target "lead generators" — operators who use social media, online ads and cold calls to funnel people's retirement into high-risk schemes.

Unlicensed real-time communication about superannuation will be banned, and licensees will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure lead generation activities comply with legal requirements.

The anti‑hawking regime will also be bolstered, with stronger consent requirements, a narrower exemption for financial advisers to existing clients, and harsher penalties for breaches.

Mulino said the reforms were designed to strengthen consumer protections and disrupt "predatory and inappropriate behaviour" that led to the collapse of the Shield and First Guardian funds.

"Lead generators reaching out to these people in unsolicited ways, undertaking highly manipulative interactions to convince them that their super products were not performing well or were inappropriate, and then manipulating them into inappropriate products for them," Mulino told ABC radio on Wednesday morning.

The government previously floated the measures in a consultation paper published in April.

title.en: Five Sydney Swans players to sit out the rest of the season amid sexual assault investigation
title.zh: 悉尼天鹅队五名球员因性侵犯调查将缺席本赛季剩余比赛

summary.en: The five players have been named and will not be participating in the rest of the 2026 AFL season.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Sydney Swans players involved in an alleged sexual assault investigation will sit out the remainder of the 2026 season, the club has confirmed.

The players have been named as Riley Bice, Nick Blakey, Isaac Heeney, James Jordon and Chad Warner and will "not be considered for selection for the remainder of the 2026 AFL Season," the club announced on Wednesday morning.

"We respect there is an ongoing investigation by Victoria Police and the actions we have taken today are independent of this."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Sydney Swans chairman Andrew Pridham and CEO Matthew Pavlich will be speaking to the media on Wednesday afternoon.

Victoria Police attended the Pullman Hotel in East Melbourne on Monday to investigate a sexual assault report in the early hours of the morning.

Five players were linked to the police investigation and have not been arrested or charged.

The club's board met on Tuesday night to agree on player sanctions and penalties, which they say occurred after the club "concluded its interviews" with the players involved in the incident.

"The Club believes the players are in serious breach of expected Club behaviour and standards, and it is appropriate to take firm action and highlight that any sanction we impose relates solely to those breaches," the club said in a statement on Tuesday evening.

"The Club also acknowledges that these serious allegations impact others and their wellbeing must be paramount.

"The Sydney Swans condemn all forms of abuse and disrespectful behaviour towards women."

It said any further sanctions or decisions regarding the outcome of the police investigation would take place after that process is completed.

Australian Football League (AFL) CEO Andrew Dillon also released a statement on Tuesday evening, saying the incident raised "broader issues for our game and our responsibilities as a sport".

"The woman who made the report to police is entitled to privacy and care, and that should be respected," Dillon said.

"Sexual assault allegations are serious, regardless of who is involved, what time of year it is, or what they may mean for a season."

Dillon said the AFL and Sydney Swans will "consider the broader conduct of the players as more information comes to light".

This is a developing story and this article will be updated with further details shortly.

title.en: I'm a 'professional complainer'. Here's the process you must follow to get results
title.zh: 我是一个“职业抱怨者”。这是获得结果必须遵循的过程

summary.en: Lawyer and academic Maggie Hall says there is an 'art' to complaining consisting of two main rules.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Aussies have long held a narrative of the resilient "battler". But recent history suggests the days of "she'll be right" may be behind us. Insight explores whether the little Aussie battler still exists or whether a culture of complaint has taken over. Watch Insight episode Wired to Whinge on SBS On Demand.

My successes in the art of complaining have ranged from a $400 payment from my bank when they failed to get me a replacement transaction card before an overseas trip, to a payout for medical bills from an airline on behalf of a friend's mother who was injured on the plane.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Born in the 50s, I grew up mostly in Sydney's inner-west in a time when even an eye roll was perhaps considered subversive of the notion that we shouldn't complain too much.

Because of this, I was always terrified of being seen as a whinger and would bury any grievances I had about all the ways women were treated.

Then feminists such as Germaine Greer and Betty Friedan hit my consciousness at around age 15, and I realised how much women endured, which made me have newfound respect for my mum.

Despite this awareness, I continued for the next decade to put up with many experiences I believed were just typical for young women.

I didn't complain when I spent half a day getting ready for a date, and they'd show up looking like they just fell out of bed; I didn't complain when my bum was pinched as a barmaid or when I'd have to lock myself in a storeroom to avoid the advances of a coworker.

It wasn't until my mid-20s, working as a social worker, mostly in the criminal justice system, that I was surrounded by many women who taught me I didn't need to put up with it.

Then, when I was a 34-year-old mother of two, I earned my law degree and really felt empowered to complain, as it taught me how to navigate the systems and rules that structure society.

I thought, "I know the system. I know how it's supposed to work, so I'm not going to keep my mouth shut anymore."

As a social worker and solicitor, who also worked for the NSW Ombudsman, I've learnt a lot from other “professional complainers” over the past four decades — even if some seemed worn from battling bureaucracy and institutions.

My "professional complaining" has largely been advocating for others for housing and those experiencing addiction. People call me up with an issue they need help with, and they know I'll gladly open my big mouth and advocate for them, wasting no time to get their issues resolved.

I think people could complain more, but they don't know how to do it successfully; there is a process you must follow to be a good complainer.

title.en: Want lower energy bills? You might want to skip this popular upgrade first
title.zh: 想要更低的能源账单？你可能要先跳过这个热门升级

summary.en: A popular home energy upgrade is often on wishlists, but researchers suggest there are more effective ways to maximize savings before investing in it.
summary.zh: 一项热门的家庭能源升级项目常在许多人的愿望清单上，但研究人员指出，在投入资金之前，有更明智的方法可以最大限度地节省开支。

body.en:
Many Australians want to go fully electric. But it’s often hard to know where to start. Solar? A home battery? Or quitting gas?

To find the best way to make the shift, we modelled three pathways for a three-bedroom house in Melbourne’s western suburbs.

These pathways show it’s important to do things in the right order. It’s best to start by lowering energy demand through better insulation and stopping draughts, and then switch from gas heating to an efficient reverse-cycle air conditioner. Home batteries should ideally be done last.

We used benchmark data to model a household with ducted gas heating, gas hot water and cooktop, common electric household appliances and a petrol car.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Each year this household uses 5,300 kilowatt-hours of electricity, just under 50 gigajoules of gas, and about 1,230 litres of petrol (to drive 11,100 kilometres). This costs $2,477 for electricity, $1,494 for gas and $2,255 for petrol. Total energy costs are $6,226 a year.

We modelled replacing these with a 10-kilowatt ducted reverse-cycle air conditioner, a hot water heat pump and an induction cooktop.

We also modelled two further options: one where the household switches to a mid-range EV with a battery of about 60kWh and another where the household keeps its petrol car.

We tested three pathways to going electric. These don’t include rebates or the cost of the EV.

Here, the household adds a large 11.76kW solar array, gets off gas and replaces its petrol car with an EV.

Although total electricity use rises, the grid electricity bill falls due to solar. The new electricity bill would be about $1,800. Because gas and petrol costs fall to zero, the household saves about $4,400 yearly.

This pathway mirrors the first, but adds a 13.5kWh home battery at the end. The power bill falls to about $950. Savings would be about $5,300.

Here, the household doubles storage to 27kWh. The power bill drops to about $600. It doesn’t reach zero due to low solar over some periods and annual supply charges. Annual savings: about $5,900.

These figures combine the prices in Victoria's official guide with advertised price benchmarks for installed appliances as of June 2026. The hot water heat pump is costed after an upfront discount. These pathways don’t directly hold for other regions, due to factors such as climatic difference and government incentives.

Governments offer a range of rebates and subsidies for households to go electric.
